## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite Name:** Consultation Request and Prescription Management

**Target Application:** Virtual Healthcare System

**Test Suite Description:** This suite verifies the functionality of consultation request and prescription management within the Virtual Healthcare System.

**Test Suite Scope:**

* Consultation request generation and review by doctors.
* Prescription generation, delivery, and collection.
* Lab report generation and delivery.

**Test Suite Preconditions:**

* The Virtual Healthcare System is running.
* Admin has set up specialties, doctors, labs, and pharmacies.

**Test Suite Postconditions:**

* Consultation request is reviewed by doctor and a diagnosis is provided.
* Prescription is generated and sent to patient, chemist, and labs.
* Chemist delivers medications to the patient.
* Labs collect specimen from the patient and deliver lab report to the patient and update the report in the system.

**Test Suite Requirements:**

| Requirement ID | Requirement Description |
|---|---|
| VIRTUA-2.2-5 | When patient generates a consultation request then doctor sees that request and gives the diagnosis. |
| VIRTUA-2.2-6 | The prescription generated by doctor is sent to patient,chemist and labs. |
| VIRTUA-2.2-7 | Chemist use this prescription to deliver the desired medicines to the patient. |
| VIRTUA-2.2-8 | Labs too use the prescription to collect specimen from the patient and deliver lab report to the patient and update the report into the system for future reference for the patient. |
| VIRTUA-2.3-1 | Admin shall be able to set up specialties |
| VIRTUA-2.3-2 | Admin shall be able to add doctors |
| VIRTUA-2.3-3 | Admin shall be able to add labs and pharmacy |
| VIRTUA-2.3-4 | Admin shall be able to edit doctors information (update/delete) |
